readout_other: hippocampal LFP theta amplitude and power
direction_notes: Theta amplitude and absolute power increased after TUS while relative power decreased; the relative change depended on trial number and stimulation duration under peak stimulation only.

exposures.label: Closed-loop TUS at theta peak, trough or random phase

timing.protocol_description: Ultrasound triggered at the predicted peak, trough or a random phase of the hippocampal theta rhythm; PRF 1 kHz, DC 30%, stimulation duration 20-60 ms, 1-6 stimulation trials (SD 50 ms for the trial experiments, six trials for the duration experiments). Experiments repeated 16 times per setting with 5 s intervals and 15 min between settings.

source_quotes.n_subjects: A total of25 C57BL mice were used in the experiment, (body weights 20–25 g, Beijing Vital River Laboratory Animal Technology Co., Ltd, China, peak stimulation: $N = 7 ;$ trough stimulation: $N = 7 ;$ random stimulation: $N = 6 ;$ deaf mouse group: $N = 5 )
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: An FF of 500 kHz was chosen to obtain deeper penetration.
source_quotes.exposures[0].unspecified_domain.pressure: A sound pressure of 0.18 MPa and DC of 30% were chosen to the reduce the thermal effect of TUS in the brain tissue.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.duty_cycle_pct: A sound pressure of 0.18 MPa and DC of 30% were chosen to the reduce the thermal effect of TUS in the brain tissue.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.pulse_repetition_fre: The PRF and range of SD were 1 kHz and 20–60 ms, respectively.
source_quotes.exposures[0].timing.sonication_duration_: The PRF and range of SD were 1 kHz and 20–60 ms, respectively.

flags.reason: Paper says 'sound pressure of 0.18 MPa' without stating whether water or in-brain; recorded as unspecified. Intensity is mentioned as a setting but no value is given.
Pulse duration not stated (DC 30% and PRF 1 kHz given); left not_reported per no-arithmetic rule.

Closed-loop phase-locked stimulation; number of stimulation trials (1-6) per theta peak/trough and stimulation duration (20-60 ms) varied. Paper text also says the transducer was aligned to the motor cortex in one sentence, inconsistent with the hippocampal target.
Hippocampus coordinates given (2 mm right, 2 mm posterior of bregma); section 2.4 mentions aligning to the motor cortex, likely a copy-over.
